description: This file defines the StatementLoggingCustomizer class, which implements the EntityManagerFactoryCustomizer interface to customize JPA entity manager properties, specifically configuring SQL logging levels.

classes.name: StatementLoggingCustomizer
classes.description: A Spring component that customizes JPA entity manager factory settings to enable detailed SQL logging.

methods.name: additionalVendorProperties
methods.description: Returns a map of vendor-specific properties to configure SQL logging level and parameters for the persistence provider.
